Thanks for the ping — dug into the attached .ics. Root cause: organizer is scheduling@novastack.com and the forwarded copy replaced the <JOIN_URL> token with a Meet placeholder that points to their calendar service; when our original token is stripped the Meet URL resolves to a non-existent resource for external guests.

Fix and recommendation:
- Create a fresh event from redwood.ai (we will be organizer) at the same time slot.
- Use our Zoom join (https://zoom.us/j/9876543210) and set the event visibility / reminders identical to the original.
- Mark the event title "Redwood — Demo with NovaStack (resend)" so it's easy to accept.
- Attach the new .ics and, in the message body, instruct recipients not to forward the event to preserve the token.

I've generated a draft .ics (resend-invite.ics) and toggled the organizer field to tessa.morgan@redwood.ai. If you want, I can hit send now.

- Logan
